sharedStoryClusters.story: French Unrest and Curfews Imposed in Paris and Nice
sharedStoryClusters.summary: Following severe nationwide riots, looting, and widespread arrests over living costs, French authorities implemented localized nighttime curfews across major cities including Paris, Marseille, and Nice. Courts have initiated hasty trials for dozens arrested during the violence, while outlets highlight extensive business property damage, shopkeepers fearing livelihood destruction, a French 10-year bond yield hitting 5% for the first time since 2002, ongoing tourist disruptions amid political debates, looted goods appearing on resale sites, and high schoolers recounting police custody.
sharedStoryClusters.developmentNote: France 24 reports partial nighttime curfews enacted across Paris and Nice following widespread riots.

sharedStoryClusters.story: French Unrest and Curfews Imposed in Paris and Nice
sharedStoryClusters.summary: Following severe nationwide riots, looting, and widespread arrests over living costs, French authorities implemented localized nighttime curfews across major cities including Paris, Marseille, and Nice. Courts have initiated hasty trials for dozens arrested during the violence, while outlets highlight extensive business property damage, shopkeepers fearing livelihood destruction, a French 10-year bond yield hitting 5% for the first time since 2002, ongoing tourist disruptions amid political debates, looted goods appearing on resale sites, and high schoolers recounting police custody.
